answer.value: Dense architecture (31B Dense) with hybrid attention interleaving local sliding window attention and full global attention; the Gemma 4 family includes Dense and Mixture-of-Experts variants
quotes: Featuring both Dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, Gemma 4 is well-suited for tasks like text generation, coding, and reasoning.
The models employ a hybrid attention mechanism that interleaves local sliding window attention with full global attention, ensuring the final layer is always global.
